text.tspan: vory Madonna dying in the dust,
aiting for the manna coming from the west
rren is her bosom, empty as her eyes,
eath a certain harvest scattered from the skies.
kin and bones is creeping, doesn't know he's dead.
Ancient eyes are peeping, from his infant head.
Drawing up their Bargains, trading baby lives.
Hear the bells are ringing, Christmas on it's way
Hear the angels singing, what is that they say?
Eat and drink rejoicing, joy is here to stay.
Jesus son of Mary is born again today.
